# Time Editor

## Summary
The edit-format component that ships inside the field — a time-of-day input writing { value: 'HH:MM' }. Declaring
the field is all it takes; the editor renders wherever the card is edited.

## Example
```ts
import TimeField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/time';

@field value = contains(TimeField);
```
Custom editors replace it by overriding the field's `edit` format; the
value-attribute + input-event binding pattern applies.
